name: Aggressive Federal Reserve 75 bps Rate Hikes & Tech De-Rating
description: Historic runaway inflation print (8.6% CPI) forces the Federal Reserve to implement the largest benchmark rate hike in 28 years (+75 bps), causing steep bond duration losses and equity de-ratings.

headlines.text: US Consumer Price Index accelerates to fresh 40-year peak of 8.6% in May, shattering expectations of an inflation plateau and driving 2-year yields to 2008 highs.
Wall Street Journal dispatches signal the Federal Reserve is actively preparing a jumbo 75 basis point rate increase at Wednesday's FOMC meeting.
Federal Reserve delivers historic 75 basis point rate hike, the biggest single-meeting rate increase since 1994, and signals ongoing restrictive policy trajectory.
Swiss National Bank and Bank of England follow with surprise tightening moves; global equity markets tumble into formal bear market territory.
